title: IoT Beverage Bottling Control & Monitoring System
description: An industrial automation system embedded on a Raspberry Pi Pico 2W that implements real-time control of a beverage bottling production line. Developed in CircuitPython with MQTT for IoT telemetry, it features double-loop speed control, defensive algorithms for stall and fault detection, and a 2D web-based simulator with hardware mockups and fault injection.
